notes.title: Update 5th September 2019
notes.content:
New update is released and the change logs are:

- Three collectable balls are added.
- Four Steam Achievements are added.
- Collection page is added at the Pause Menu.

Enjoy =)

tags.feature: - Collection page is added at the Pause Menu.

notes.title: Game Update 3rd September 2019
notes.content:
I've updated the game and here's the change log:

- Autosave is added.
- GameOver issue is fixed.
- If you saved the game in any save file, its color will change to notify you that it exists.

Enjoy =)

tags.feature: - If you saved the game in any save file, its color will change to notify you that it exists.
